ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca (Aquatic Panda) post-exploitation: web-facing process spawning multi-command recon chain
ucs.description: Hunts Earth Lusca's signature web-shell follow-on: an IIS/Tomcat/Java worker process (w3wp.exe, tomcat.exe, java.exe, httpd.exe) spawning a tightly-clustered Windows discovery chain (whoami → systeminfo → net group 'domain admins' → tasklist → ipconfig → nltest /dclist) within minutes of dropping a China Chopper / Behinder web shell after ProxyShell, Log4j, GoAnywhere CVE-2023-0669 or ManageEngine CVE-2022-47966 exploitation. Aquatic Panda / Bronze University / Charcoal Typhoon repeatedly runs this exact recon block under the IIS worker identity — and the 3+ distinct discovery binaries under t
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, dc(Processes.process_name) as recon_count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, values(Processes.process) as commands, values(Processes.process_name) as recon_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","tasklist.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","hostname.exe","route.exe","query.exe") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*whoami*","*systeminfo*","*net user*","*net group *Domain Admins*","*net localgroup *administrators*","*nltest /dclist*","*nltest /domain_trusts*","*tasklist /svc*","*ipconfig /all*","*arp -a*","*query session*"))) by host, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process_id, Processes.user | where recon_count >= 3 | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - recon_count
ucs.kql:
let WebWorkers = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe"]);
let ReconBins   = dynamic(["whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","tasklist.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","hostname.exe","route.exe","query.exe"]);
let ReconCmds  = dynamic(["whoami","systeminfo","net user","net group \"domain admins\"","net localgroup administrators","nltest /dclist","nltest /domain_trusts","tasklist /svc","ipconfig /all","arp -a","query session"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (WebWorkers)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
   or (FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any (ReconCmds))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // exclude machine accounts
| summarize ReconCount = dcount(FileName),
            ReconChain = make_set(strcat(FileName, " :: ", substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 160)), 25),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, WebWorker = InitiatingProcessFileName, WebWorkerPid = InitiatingProcessId
| where ReconCount >= 3   // Earth Lusca consistently chains 3+ recon binaries under the IIS worker PID
| order by ReconCount desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WebWorkers = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe"]);
let ReconBins   = dynamic(["whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","tasklist.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","hostname.exe","query.exe"]);
let ReconCmds  = dynamic(["whoami","systeminfo","net user","net group","net localgroup","nltest /dclist","nltest /domain_trusts","tasklist /svc","ipconfig /all","arp -a","query session"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,   "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (WebWorkers)
| where ChildName in (ReconBins)
   or (ChildName in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any (ReconCmds))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize ReconCount = dcount(ChildName),
            Commands  = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, ParentName, ParentPid = ProcessId, SubjectUserName
| where ReconCount >= 3   // 3+ discovery binaries under one web-worker PID = Aquatic Panda recon chain
| order by ReconCount desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\tomcat*.exe OR *\\Tomcat*.exe OR *\\java.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\javaw.exe OR *\\httpd.exe OR *\\nginx.exe) @Image:(*\\whoami.exe OR *\\Whoami.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\Systeminfo.exe OR *\\ipconfig.exe OR *\\Ipconfig.exe OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\Tasklist.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\Nltest.exe OR *\\quser.exe OR *\\arp.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|tomcat\d*|java|javaw|httpd|nginx)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(whoami|net1?|systeminfo|ipconfig|tasklist|nltest|quser|arp|hostname|query|cmd|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ParentProcessId, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, as=ReconCount, distinct=true), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])])
| ReconCount >= 3
ucs.rationale: The combination (web-server worker PID as parent + ≥3 distinct Windows discovery binaries + 'net group Domain Admins' in arg-space) is a documented Aquatic Panda / Earth Lusca tradecraft fingerprint repeatedly observed by CrowdStrike (Aquatic Panda Log4Shell academic-institution intrusion, December 2021) and Trend Micro (Earth Lusca ProxyShell campaign, 2022). Generic 'powershell from w3wp' alerts

ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca Cobalt Strike DLL sideloading: signed-vendor loader executing from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts Earth Lusca's signature Cobalt Strike delivery: a legitimate signed vendor binary they consistently abuse for sideloading — AvastSvc.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, aswRunSchTask.exe, chrome_frame_helper.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, RoboTaskBarIcon.exe, vfhost.exe, rekeywiz.exe — executing from %ProgramData%, %Public%, %Temp%, %AppData% or %PerfLogs% instead of its installed Program Files path. Earth Lusca drops the renamed signed loader + paired malicious DLL (e.g., aswEng.dll, log.dll, FunnySwitch loader) into the same writable directory, then the DLL stages an encrypted/steganographic Cobalt Strike bea
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, values(Processes.process) as cmd, values(Processes.process_path) as paths, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent, values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AvastSvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","aswRunSchTask.exe","chrome_frame_helper.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","GoogleCrashHandler.exe","RoboTaskBarIcon.exe","vfhost.exe","rekeywiz.exe","OneDrive.exe","mscorsvw.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*") by host, Processes.process_name, Processes.process_path, Processes.process_id, Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join host process_id type=left [| tstats summariesonly=true values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dst_ip, values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dst_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.process_id=* by host, All_Traffic.process_id | rename All_Traffic.process_id as process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["avastsvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","aswrunschtask.exe","chrome_frame_helper.exe","googleupdate.exe","googlecrashhandler.exe","robotaskbaricon.exe","vfhost.exe","rekeywiz.exe","onedrive.exe","mscorsvw.exe","goopdate.exe"]);
let WritableDirs  = dynamic([@"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
let Sideloaders = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | where FolderPath has_any (WritableDirs)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, SideloadHost = FileName,
              SideloadPath = FolderPath, SideloadPid = ProcessId, ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName;
Sideloaders
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (WritableDirs)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | project DllTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, SideloadPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              SideloadedDll = FileName, SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath, DllSha256 = SHA256
  ) on DeviceName, SideloadPid
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, SideloadPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
  ) on DeviceName, SideloadPid
| where isnotempty(SideloadedDll) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, SideloadHost, SideloadPath, ParentImage,
          SideloadedDll, SideloadedDllPath, DllSha256, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["avastsvc.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","aswrunschtask.exe","chrome_frame_helper.exe","googleupdate.exe","googlecrashhandler.exe","robotaskbaricon.exe","vfhost.exe","rekeywiz.exe","onedrive.exe","mscorsvw.exe","goopdate.exe"]);
let WritableDirs  = dynamic([@"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImagePath = tolower(NewProcessName),
         ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImageName in (SideloadHosts)
| where ImagePath has_any (WritableDirs)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessId = ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Earth Lusca DLL Sideloading via Signed Vendor Loader in Writable Path
id: 6d3b9c54-1f4a-4d83-b9e1-earthlusca-sideload
status: experimental
description: Detects known DLL-sideloading host binaries (AvastSvc.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, chrome_frame_helper.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, RoboTaskBarIcon.exe, etc.) executing from user-writable directories — the hallmark of Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda / TAG-22 Cobalt Strike loader chains documented by Trend Micro and Recorded Future.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/a/earth-lusca-sophisticated-infrastructure-varied-tools-and-techni.html
  - https://www.recordedfuture.com/threat-intelligence/tag-22-china-southeast-asia
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.001
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AvastSvc.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\aswRunSchTask.exe'
      - '\chrome_frame_helper.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\GoogleCrashHandler.exe'
      - '\RoboTaskBarIcon.exe'
      - '\vfhost.exe'
      - '\rekeywiz.exe'
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Vendor installers temporarily executing signed helpers from %TEMP% during install (verify against software-deployment windows)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\AvastSvc.exe OR *\\avastsvc.exe OR *\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\\aswRunSchTask.exe OR *\\aswrunschtask.exe OR *\\chrome_frame_helper.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\googleupdate.exe OR *\\GoogleCrashHandler.exe OR *\\RoboTaskBarIcon.exe OR *\\robotaskbaricon.exe OR *\\vfhost.exe OR *\\rekeywiz.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\onedrive.exe OR *\\goopdate.exe) (@Image:*\\Users\\Public\\* OR @Image:*\\users\\public\\* OR @Image:*\\ProgramData\\* OR @Image:*\\programdata\\* OR @Image:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR @Image:*\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR @Image:*\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR @Image:*\\windows\\temp\\* OR @Image:*\\PerfLogs\\* OR @Image:*\\perflogs\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(AvastSvc|wsc_proxy|aswRunSchTask|chrome_frame_helper|GoogleUpdate|GoogleCrashHandler|RoboTaskBarIcon|vfhost|rekeywiz|OneDrive|goopdate)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(Users\\Public|ProgramData|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|Windows\\Temp|PerfLogs)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, UserName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData, TargetProcessId])])
ucs.rationale: Earth Lusca's CS loader inventory is unusually consistent across campaigns — Trend Micro's January 2022 report and Recorded Future's TAG-22 reporting both document the same handful of AV/OEM signed binaries (AvastSvc.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe family) abused as DLL-sideloading hosts dropped into %ProgramData% / %Public% / %Temp%. Those binaries NEVER legitimately execute from those paths
